mostWorthwhile.text: The matched water comparisons were most worthwhile: they showed that aquaporin speeds exchange without changing the direction of net movement under the same starting conditions.

leastWorthwhile.text: Installing the two channels was straightforward and somewhat repetitive, though it made the subsequent transport comparisons possible.

surprise.text: The lipid-only patch allowed slow water exchange in both directions; the channel increased the rate rather than creating the only route for water.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The initial inspection was cautious, but it exposed the sole available operation and automatically made the membrane.

continue.text: Yes, I would choose to continue: the planned comparisons connected membrane structure to transport clearly, and I would be curious to see how later constructions develop those connections.
